name: True Damage
description: Add 1 damage to any Technique.
op_1_desc: Add 1 additional damage.

name: Reaction
description: 25% EN: This technique uses a Basic (or other) reaction instead of action.

name: Long Action
description: -12.5% EN: This technique uses a 3 Action Point Long Action.
op_1_desc: -25% EN: This technique uses a 4 Action Point Long Action.

name: Quick or Free Action
description: 25% EN: This technique uses a quick action to activate instead of a basic action.
op_1_desc: 50% EN: This technique uses a free action to activate instead of a basic action

name: Split Damage Dice
description: A 'Split' damage dice is when dice could be represented by less dice of greater size, but are 'split' into smaller sizes instead. Ie 2d6 instead of 1d12 represents one die 'split' by splitting 1d12 into 2d6.
op_1_desc: Each additional time a die is split, ie 3d4 instead of 1d12 is 2 splits instead of 1, this part increases by one.

name: Additional Damage
description: Add 1d4 damage to the technique.
op_1_desc: Add an additional 1d2 damage to this technique.

name: Add Weapon to Technique
description: Add a weapon attack to this technique.

name: Reckless
description: When you are the target of an attack, you may choose to let the attack hit you to use this technique, before you know the outcome of the attack, or if you know the attack would miss. If this is the only part, you may use it as a reaction.

name: Pass Through
description:
As you move directly toward your target, you may make attack rolls against any creatures you pass that are within your melee range. You may use one roll for all targets or roll individually for each.
You use this technique before moving toward your desired target. If you are unable to reach them as expected, you still use energy as normal and can still attack targets on the path you took, if direct.

name: Spin
description: Roll to hit once, but target all creatures within the reach of your melee attack.

name: Stun
description: Target hit rolls Fortitude against your Martial Potency. On a failure, the target gains Stunned 1 for 2 rounds.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of Stunned by 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the duration of Stunned by 1 round.

name: Wind Up
description: Gain a +1 to your Damage Roll as part of this technique, or your next Attack, for every 2 spaces of movement you spend. Spent movement includes any Speed gained from your movement action or other sources of movement that you choose to forfeit for this action.
op_1_desc: Make this +1 per 1 space of movement instead.

name: Knockback
description: Upon a hit, the target rolls their choice of Might or Reflexes against your Martial Potency and, on a failure, is knocked back 1 space.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN per space you knock the target back (away from your character) to a maximum of 6 spaces.
op_2_desc: 1 TP to raise maximum knockback by 2 (e.g., up to 8, 10, and so on).

name: Slow
description: Target hit rolls Fortitude against your Martial Potency; on a failure, the target gains Slow 1 for one round.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN for each increased level of the Slow condition.
op_2_desc: 1.5 EN For each additional round Slow lasts.

name: Daze
description: Target hit rolls Fortitude against your Martial Potency; on a failure, becomes dazed for one round.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional round dazed.

name: Wide Swing
description: This attack targets three connected spaces in your melee range; roll to attack once for all.

name: Enemy Strength Reduction
description: Target hit rolls Might against your Martial Potency; on a failure, their Strength decreases by 1 for one round.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN for each additional 1 Strength reduced.
op_2_desc: 2 EN for each additional round of Strength reduction.

name: Reach
description: Treat this attack as if the weapon has Reach, with which you are considered proficient during this attack.
op_1_desc: 1 EN Increase the level of Reach by 1.

name: Expose
description: Target hit rolls Reflexes against your Martial Potency; upon failure, the creature gains the Exposed 1 condition for one round or until attacked, whichever comes first.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN to cause the Exposed condition to last for an additional attack and/or round, whichever comes first.
op_2_desc: 1 EN for each additional +1 to the Exposed condition.

name: Enemy Attack Reduction
description: Target hit rolls their choice of Might or Fortitude against your Martial Potency; upon failure, the target has -1 to attack for a round.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN for each additional -1 to attack.
op_2_desc: 1 EN for each additional round.

name: Bleed
description: Target hit gains the Bleed 1 condition for one minute.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN for each +1 to the Bleed condition.

name: Situational Exploit
description: -25% EN: Technique can only be used when a target misses you with an attack roll. Adding this part makes this Technique usable as a basic reaction.

name: Upward Thrust
description: Target hit rolls Reflexes or Might against your Martial Potency, adding +2 to the roll for every 200 kg they weigh; upon failure, it is thrust 1 space into the air above its current space.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN for each additional space upward to a maximum of 5.

name: Strength Knock Prone
description: Target hit rolls Might against your Martial Potency, falling prone on a failure.

name: Pin
description: Attack target’s Might, +1 to your attack for every 200 kg you weigh. Target hit is immobile and may roll Might against your Martial Potency to escape. Rolling to escape has a penalty equal to -1 for every 200 kg you weigh.

name: Grapple (Technique)
description: You take the Grapple Action as part of this Technique. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Quick Action.

name: Crush
description: Roll a Strength Attack against a target creature already grappled by you; if you hit, the target takes damage equal to your Strength Attack Bonus. Targets Fortitude
op_1_desc: +2 EN to double this damage, +2 EN more to triple it, and so on.

name: Body Block
description: Make a Strength Attack roll against target creature grappled by you; on success, the creature becomes the target of an attack made against you. If the attack would cause the grappled creature to go into negative Health, you take all damage after 0 instead. If the grappled creature is already dead or dying, it instead reduces the damage by its Fortitude bonus. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Reaction. Targets Might

name: Restrain
description: Make a Strength Attack roll against target creature's Might, who is grappled by you; on success, it gains the Restrained condition until no longer grappled.

name: Takedown
description: Make an Unarmed Attack roll against target creature grappled by you; on success, it becomes prone. As long as they remain grappled by you, they cannot stand from prone. Targets Might

name: Throw Creature
description: Make an unarmed Attack roll against target creature grappled by you; on success, throw the target grappled creature as if they were a thrown weapon with a range of 3 spaces. 1d8 damage is split between the thrown creature and the object or creature hit, +1 damage for each 100 kg the creature weighs. The creature must weigh under 1/2 of your carrying capacity to throw. Targets Might
op_1_desc: +3 to the throne range.
op_2_desc: +1d2 to the thrown damage.

name: Throw Weapon
description: Throw any weapon even if it doesn't have the 'Thrown' property, treating it as a thrown weapon with 3 spaces of range, rolling a Strength attack roll with proficiency against a target, and dealing damage equal to the weapon’s damage as normal.
op_1_desc: 3 EN for each +3 to the thrown range

name: Leap
description: Jump without taking a movement action. If this is the only part, this can be done as a free action.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN to double your Jump distance with this action. +1.5 EN more to triple your Jump distance instead.

name: Reduce Multiple Action Penalty
description: Reduce the multiple action penalty this turn by 1. If this is the only part, this can be done as a free action.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional 1 decrease.

name: Demolition
description: Damage dealt by Technique deals double damage to objects, walls, ceilings, etc.
op_1_desc: 2 EN and +1 TP to triple damage dealt to objects, walls, ceilings, instead.

name: Slam
description: Target hit rolls Fortitude against your Martial Potency (which gains a +1 bonus for every 200 kg you weigh for this part). Upon failure, the target takes damage equal to your Vitality + your Martial Bonus.
op_1_desc: 4 EN to double this damage. +4 EN more to triple, and so on.

name: Head Butt
description: Roll Fortitude against target’s Fortitude; upon a success, target takes damage equal to your Vitality + your Martial Bonus; on a failure, you take damage equal to target’s Fortitude.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN to double this damage. +1.5 EN more to triple, and so on. This doubles both the damage dealt on success and taken on failure.

name: Weaken (Technique)
description: Target hit rolls Fortitude against your Martial Potency and on failure gains the Weakened 1 condition for one round.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of Weakened by 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the duration of Weakened by 1 round.

name: Make Susceptible
description: Target hit gains the Susceptible 1 condition for one round.
op_1_desc: 2 EN for each level of Susceptible.
op_2_desc: 8 EN The Susceptible condition lasts for one minute instead. Target can roll on subsequent turns to overcome this condition with Fortitude.

name: Brace
description: Take the Brace action as part of this Technique. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: 2 EN to double the brace reduction, +2 EN more to triple it, and so on.

name: Parry
description: Take the Defend Reaction with any weapon as if it had the "Block" Property. If this is the only part added, it can be done as a Quick Reaction.

name: Unarmed Hit(s)
description: Add a single unarmed prowess hit to your attack in addition to any attack made as part of the Technique.
op_1_desc: Add a second unarmed prowess hit.
op_2_desc: Add a third unarmed prowess hit.
op_3_desc: Add a fourth unarmed prowess hit.

name: Agile Knock Prone
description: Target hit rolls Reflex against your Martial Potency, falling prone on a failure.

name: Charge
description: Add +1 to damage for every 2 spaces moved in the direction of the target in as direct a path as possible.
op_1_desc: Add +1 for every 1 space instead. +3 EN more to make this +2 for every 1 space, and so on.

name: Finesse Strike/Shot
description: Attack as if this weapon had the Finesse Property, with which you are considered proficient during this Attack.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN add +1/2 Agility to the attack and damage roll of this attack; you may choose whether or not to consider the weapon attack to have Finesse with this attack. 1.5 EN more to add your full Agility instead.

name: Disarm
description: Attempt to disarm a target of an item they're holding. Target hit rolls Might or Reflex against your Martial Potency, +3 to the target’s roll if the item you’re disarming is two-handed. Upon failure, the target drops the target item.

name: Break Sight
description: Move from one location to another within a target’s Melee Range and roll Stealth or Hide against their Perceive Score; upon a success, you have the Hidden condition to that target.

name: Disengage
description: Move one space away from a target after it attacks you, whether it hits or not. If this is the only part of the Technique, it can be used as a Free Reaction.

name: Catch Ranged Attack
description: Roll Reflex against a physical ranged attack that passes through or targets a creature within one space. Upon meeting or beating the attack roll, catch the projectile and reduce the damage to 0. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Reaction.
op_1_desc: Caught projectiles can be thrown as part of the same action in which they were caught by making a thrown improvised weapon attack against any target within half the range of the original attack.

name: Catch Melee Attack
description: Roll Reflex against a physical melee attack that passes through or targets a creature within one space. Upon meeting or beating the attack roll, catch the attack. During the same action in which the attack was caught, you have a +2 Bonus on all physical D20 rolls against the target caught creature. This doesn't cause the grapple condition on its own. This includes attack rolls. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Reaction.

name: Hide
description: You gain the Hidden Condition from all creatures to which you are at least moderately obscured without needing a roll to Stealth or Hide. Alternatively, you may choose to roll to Stealth or Hide. This counts as taking the Stealth/Hide Action. If this is the only Technique part, this can be done as a Quick Action.

name: Evade
description: You take the Evade Action as part of the Technique. If this is the one part of the technique, it can be done as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: 2 EN for each equivalent of 1 action point spent on the Evade action.

name: Maneuver
description: You take the Movement Action as part of the Technique without spending action points, but only moving half of the movement you'd usually get from that action. If this is the only technique part, this may be done as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: 2 EN to allow you to move the full movement speed of that action instead.

name: Side-Step
description: When an attack targeting your Evasion would hit you, you may add +1 to your Evasion, and you may move one space adjacent to your current space that is still within the attack’s range. If this is the only part, this can be done as a Quick reaction. This can cause the attack to miss, but it doesn't guarantee it.
op_1_desc: 2 EN for each +1 to your Evasion.

name: Switch
description: Switch places with a willing creature within your melee range or an unwilling creature that you either hit with this attack or who fails a Might or Reflexes roll against your Martial Potency. This doesn’t trigger any effects based on moving in or out of melee range for you or the enemy.

name: Focus Hit
description: Gain a +1 to an Attack Roll as part of this technique, or your next Attack, for every 2 spaces of movement you spend. Spent movement includes any Speed gained from your movement action or other sources of movement that you choose to forfeit for this action.
op_1_desc: 3 EN to add +1 for every 1 space you spend. +3 EN more to make this +2 for every 1 space, and so on.

name: Rush
description: Add +1 to this attack roll for every 2 spaces moved in the direction of the target as directly as possible.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN to add +1 for every 1 space you move in the direction of the target. +2.5 EN more to make this +2 for every 1 space, and so on.

name: Vital Point
description: Add 1/2 Acuity to your melee attack roll.
op_1_desc: 3 EN to add your full Acuity to your melee attack roll.

name: Feint
description: Roll Act or Deceive against an enemy’s Insight Score, gaining +1 to hit for each success.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for every +1 to hit per success up to a maximum of +3.

name: Goad
description: Make a Taunt Roll against a target’s Resolve; upon success, the target becomes set on eliminating you specifically, gaining -5 to attack all creatures other than you for a round.
op_1_desc: 2 EN to target all creatures within 3 spaces that you can see, +2 EN for each additional 3 spaces of range.
op_2_desc: 2 EN Increase the duration of this effect by 1 additional round.
op_3_desc: 1 EN Increase attack reduction for other creatures by an additional -1.

name: Menace
description: Intimidate a target against their Resolve. The target gains the Frightened condition with a level equal to the number of successes on the roll, for one minute.
op_1_desc: 4 EN Increase the level of Frightened by 1 per success up to 3 levels of frightened per success.

name: Rally
description: Roll Perform or Motivate against a target you can see. The Score to overcome is equal to 10 - Target’s Resolve bonus. Upon success, the creature gains 1 level of the Resilient Condition per success attained, for one minute.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN Target an additional target, for up to 5 targets total.
op_2_desc: 2.5 EN Increase the level of Resilient by 1 per success up to 3 levels per success.

name: Defend
description: Take the Defend Reaction as part of this Technique; if this is the only part added, this may be done as a free reaction.

name: Resilience
description: Gain the Resilient 1 condition.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN for each level of Resilient.

name: Clash
description: As a Defend Reaction while weilding a melee weapon, roll and determine your weapon's damage as normal, and reduce the triggering attack by that much, instead of making an attack. If this is the only part of this Technique, it may be done as a Quick Reaction.

name: Ignore Resistance
description: This attack ignores one damage Resistance of your choice. Choose the type before attacking. (This ignores the effects of Resistance but not Damage Reduction.)
op_1_desc: You continually ignore this damage Resistance for one minute instead of just when using this technique.

name: Hidden Attack
description: Using an Interaction plus Ability Roll Action, hide this weapon with Sleight of Hand against target(s) Vigilance; if you successfully hide the weapon from an enemy when you attack, get +2 on the roll to hit.
op_1_desc: 1 EN Increase the roll to hit by +1.
op_2_desc: Deal additional damage with this technique equal to the bonus granted by this technique to the roll to hit.

name: Pinning Weapon
description: Target hit with a Melee or Thrown Piercing weapon attack rolls Might against your Martial potency, becoming Immobile on a failure for one minute. The weapon used must remain fixed in place to immobilize the target.
op_1_desc: 2.5 EN to allow this attack to be ranged piercing weapons/projectiles.

name: Command
description: Give any number of your remaining action points - not those used for this action - to a chosen willing target; they must use these action points to take actions as close to your explained desires as possible, unless you choose not to give specific commands.

name: Multi-Shot
description: Add an additional projectile to a physical ranged attack against a single target. You may choose whether to make one Attack Roll for all projectiles, or to roll separately for each. Power/Technique parts only affect the first projectile, not the added ones.
op_1_desc: Add an additional projectile, up to 4 total if shot, or 4 per hand if thrown.
op_2_desc: Power/Technique parts affect one additional projectile after the first for each level of this option.

name: Spread Shot
description: Add an additional projectile to a physical ranged attack against multiple targets. You may choose whether to make one Attack Roll for all projectiles, or to roll separately for each. You may also choose how many projectiles to target each target with, including targeting all of them at one target. Power/Technique parts only affect the first projectile, not the added ones.
op_1_desc: Add an additional projectile, up to 4 total if shot, or 4 per hand if thrown.
op_2_desc: Power/Technique parts affect one additional projectile after the first for each level of this option.

name: Long Shot
description: Increase the range of this Technique by 4 spaces if used with a Ranged or Thrown weapon.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for every 4 additional spaces.

name: Volley
description: Using a Ranged or Thrown weapon, send a volley of projectiles that can reach over cover as high as half the range of your attack. A 2-space radius circle centered in a location you can see, or at a distance you can describe if you can't see, is hit by this attack. This attack targets the Reflexes of all creatures in the attack’s area of effect.
op_1_desc: 5 EN to increase the ring’s radius by 1 to a maximum radius of 12 spaces.

name: Piercing
description: With a ranged weapon attack, each target on a path to the target is a target of this attack. This attack can pass through targets on its path to a target.

name: Curved Shot
description: This attack ignores the penalties of attacking an obscured target unless that target is fully obscured on all sides except the side facing away from you (the target does not need to be fully obscured from behind).

name: First Blood
description: Make a Basic Attack before combat starts (when initiative has already been rolled but before any creature takes their first turn). If this is the only part, this may be done as a Free Reaction.

name: Splitting Shot
description: When your ranged projectile hits or misses a target, all creatures within one space of that target (including the target) must roll Reflexes against your Martial Potency, being hit by the attack on a failure.

name: Attack / Potency Increase
description: Increase the attack roll or potency of this Power by +1.
op_1_desc: Increase by an additional +1.

name: Personal Power Attack
description: This Power becomes an option for you to use each round for its duration. Once each round, you may make another attack with this Power using the same Action it was initially used with, but without spending the energy.
op_1_desc: Decrease the Action Point cost of using this Power to attack on subsequent turns by 1.

name: Power Long Action
description: -12.5% EN: This Power uses a 3 Action Point Long Action.
op_1_desc: -25% EN: This Power uses a 4 Action Point Long Action.

name: Power Reaction
description: 25% EN: This Power uses a Basic (or other) reaction instead of action.

name: Power Quick or Free Action
description: 25% EN: This Power uses a quick action to activate instead of a basic action.
op_1_desc: 50% EN: This Power uses a free action to activate instead of a basic action

name: Rite
description: You may use a Power for free if you spend 10 minutes casting it and it meets these criteria: The total EN cost is no more than ¼ of your maximum EN. It causes no damage or healing. Its function is to locate, identify, summon, or traverse something, communicate, or seek/obtain information. If summoning, the creature summoned is at most 12.5% of your level. You can only have one summon this way.
op_1_desc: -1 EN Use this to reduce cost.

name: Long Rite
description: -50% EN: You spend 1 hour to use this Power. The total EN cost must be no more than ¼ of your maximum EN. It may cause no damage or healing. Its function must be to locate, identify, summon, or traverse something, communicate, or seek/obtain information. If summoning, the creature summoned can be at most 1/4 of your level.

name: Trigger on Condition
description: 25% EN: Make the Power activate upon certain conditions (e.g., hitting with an attack, taking damage, falling below 0 Health). Upon activation, it casts as if you were casting it normally. This does not count as a reaction. Triggered Powers cannot have the 'long cast' part. A creature can only have 1 trigger Power affecting them at a time. This trigger has a duration of 1 hour ending after this time or when it is used.
op_1_desc: 50% EN instead to make it 1 day.
op_2_desc: Double EN Instead to make it 10 days.

name: Delayed Effect
description: 25% EN: When you use this Power its effect doesn't immediately go off and it doesn't require you to overcome any defenses. You may use a free reaction at any time to cause the Power to activate. For each round the Power doesn't activate you may add an additional effect to the Power, or increase an existing effect on the Power, equal to 1/8 of this Power's energy. This Power and its effects cannot have a duration longer than 1 minute. When the Power ends if it has not been activated it automatically activates then ends.

name: Line of Effect
description: 25% EN: Each creature occupying a space directly between you and the power's target is affected by this power. Roll attack and damage once and apply it to all creatures affected.

name: Cone of Effect
description: 12.5% EN: Create a 45-degree angle cone that goes directly out from yourself for 2 spaces. Roll one attack against all targets' relevant defense.
op_1_desc: 12.5% EN: Increase this effect by +1 space.

name: Detect Creature Type
description: Detect the presence of a certain creature type within the range of this Power. The Realm Master must tell you if there are any creatures of this creature type within the range.
op_1_desc: Detect an additional creature type.

name: Detect Power
description: Target becomes aware of all Powers, magic, or supernatural effects active within a distance equal to the range of this Power.
op_1_desc: Target also learns the category of Power parts that are involved in each Power detected, or the relative category of supernatural effects (such as creation, adaptation, and so on).

name: Detect Damage
description: Detect a certain damage type within the range of this Power. Each creature, object, or environmental hazard capable of dealing that damage type becomes known to the target, including the direction or an outline shown to the target of that thing when viewing it.

name: Identify
description: Target gains awareness of a target object in range's mundane, magical, or supernatural properties, if any. According to the Realm Master's discretion, some properties may be unclear until the object is used as intended.

name: Omen
description: Gain awareness of future events that are likely to occur in the next 30 minutes based on your and others' planned courses of action. You know whether the coming events in this time are good, bad, good and bad, or neutral. Each time after the first, you use this Power in 24 hours, you have a 50% chance of it not working despite spending energy.
op_1_desc: Increase the time you gain awareness of future events that are likely to occur by 30 minutes.

name: Detect Traps
description: Detect traps within the range of this Power. You see a faint outline or aura around any traps within the range. Traps are defined as mechanisms, Powers, or objects intended to be unknowingly triggered to harm or capture creatures. This does not include natural environmental hazards or creatures awaiting ambush.

name: Locate Animals
description: You learn the direction, path, and location of the closest specified animal or beast type of your choice when you use this Power, provided it is within 2 kilometers.
op_1_desc: Increase this detection range by 2 kilometers.

name: Locate Plants
description: You learn the direction, path, and location of the closest specified plant or herb type of your choice when you use this Power, provided it is within 2 kilometers.
op_1_desc: Increase this range by 2 kilometers.

name: Locate Object
description: You learn the direction, path, and location of the closest of a specific object of your choice that is familiar to you when you use this Power provided it is within 300 meters.
op_1_desc: Increase this range by 300 meters.

name: Locate Target
description: You learn the direction, path, and location of the closest specified creature of your choice that is familiar to you when you use this Power, provided it is within 300 meters. If the creature is not in its normal form or body, then this Power fails to locate it.
op_1_desc: Increase this range by 300 meters.

name: Locate Creature on Overcome
description: If you overcome a creature's defense with any part of this Power you also learn its exact location for the next round including how far it is from you and in what direction. While detected this way it cannot be hidden from you. If this Power doesn't have an attack roll you may target Mental Fortitude instead.

name: Detect Invisibility
description: You can see Invisible things and creatures as if they were not invisible. You ignore the effects of the Invisible condition for these creatures and objects. If this is an area of effect, you may choose to cause each creature affected to gain this effect, or instead cause the area to reveal all invisible things instead. If you target a creature to end or remove its ability to be invisible, this target's Evasion. This removes or ignores the Invisible condition for you for the duration, but does not remove or ignore other sources of obscurity.

name: See Through Illusion
description: Visual illusions are almost fully invisible to you, and you automatically Overcome anything targeting Discernment related to this type of illusion.

name: Sensor
description: Create a tiny, invisible, and silent sensor that you can move a distance equal to the range of this Power as a Quick Action each turn. You can choose to hear, see, taste, and/or feel through this sensor as if it were an extension of your senses.

name: Scry
description: A tiny, silent, invisible sensor appears within 2 spaces of a specified target creature or location, no matter the location or distance from you. This sensor remains within the location or 2 spaces of the creature for this Power's duration. You can sense through it as if it's an extension of your vision and hearing. Targets Mental Fortitude or Resolve. You gain +5 to overcome if you know the target well or -5 if you've only heard of the target. In addition, you gain +2 to overcome if you have the target's picture or likeness, an additional +4 if you have a possession of the target's, and an additional +10 if you have part of its body (including hair or part of a nail). These bonuses and penalties all apply together, but each can only apply once.

name: Find Path
description: Name a specific location you are familiar with. You gain an awareness of the most direct physical route to reach it. For the duration, while you remain in the same realm as the location, you intuitively sense its distance and direction. When presented with multiple paths, you know which one is the most direct route toward your destination. This Power fails if the destination is in a different realm, is mobile (such as a floating fortress), or is too vague (like 'a dragon's lair').

name: Enrich Plantlife
description: Enrich all plant life within the range of this Power from you. The crops recover from any temporary ailment or illness; if any edible harvest is available, it is doubled for the next 30 days, although the currency value remains that of a normal harvest.
op_1_desc: +4 EN to make this affect 200 meters instead.
op_2_desc: +8 EN to make this affect one kilometer instead.

name: Liquid Walk
description: Target gains the ability to walk across any liquid as if it were a solid surface. Target may spend a Free Reaction to sink into the liquid like normal, but cannot walk on the surface again until it is able to get above the liquid.
op_1_desc: You may walk on harmful surfaces without being affected.

name: Create
description: You transform raw materials into finished products of the same material. For instance, you might craft a wooden bridge from a group of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, or clothing from flax or wool. Select raw materials within range and sight. With sufficient quantity, you can fabricate a Large or smaller object that fits within a 1-space cube or up to four connected 1-space cubes. If using metal, stone, or another ore or mineral substance, the finished object can be no larger than Medium, fitting within a 1-space cube. You cannot create Enhanced items or Creatures with this part. If you attempt to fabricate something that requires a Craft subskill, you must make the appropriate Craft skill roll, DS determined by the RM and/or crafting rules.
op_1_desc: Double the amount of a 1-space cube or up to four connected 1-space cubes to a 2-space cube or eight connected 1-space cubes.

name: Speak with the Dead
description: Target corpse temporarily animates and must answer one question it might have answered in life, with no obligation to speak honestly. The answers may be cryptic or repetitive. Once five questions have been asked, or after 10 minutes, the corpse returns to its inanimate state.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of questions you can ask by 1.

name: Health Summon
description: Create or summon a 1/4th level loyal creature Companion. You may do so by paying Health or Energy equal to this Power's Energy cost. The creature stays until killed. Your maximum Health and/or Energy is permanently lowered by the amount spent. These maximums revert to normal when the summon dies or is dismissed as a Free Action; you do not regain the lost points immediately, only your maximum Health and/or Energy returns to normal. For determining Energy costs, this Power part costs the total amount of Health and Energy spent. The creature created has no duration except as decided by you.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1/4th to a maximum level of 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1 after fully increasing it to level 1 using Option 1 to a maximum level equal to your own.

name: Summon Companion
description: Create or Summon a temporary 1/4th level Creature Companion for the Power's Duration that is loyal to you. You may choose from the Creature Library or create your own and have it approved by your Realm Master.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1/4th to a maximum level of 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1 after fully increasing it to level 1 using Option 1 to a maximum level equal to your own.

name: Neutral Summon
description: Create or summon an unaligned 1/4th level Creature. The creature has no dedicated agenda or alliance. The Realms Master controls the creature and causes it to behave according to its natural tendencies and the situation. The summon remains in the world until you take a Full Recovery or until it is killed.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1/4th to a maximum level of 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the level of the creature by 1 after fully increasing it to level 1 using Option 1 to a maximum level equal to your own.

name: Raise Undead
description: Raise a target corpse from the dead temporarily, becoming an undead (in addition to its other creature type) Companion under your control for the duration. You can only raise the corpse of a target level 1/2 or lower. Its energy and Health are returned to their normal values and maximums when raised. The raised creature has the corpse's stat block when it was alive, but its Intelligence is reduced by 2.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of raised undead to a maximum of 1 instead.
op_2_desc: Increase the maximum level of the raised creature by 1 after fully increasing it to level 1 using Option 1 to a maximum level equal to your own.

name: Weapon Summon
description: You summon a Common Rarity weapon directly to your hand. You are considered proficient with each of this weapon's Properties for the duration. If the weapon requires ammunition, you have access to it for the duration. You may decide which weapon to summon when using this Power, provided its Rarity is within the limit of what the Power allows. You may use your Power Potency and Bonus when using this weapon as opposed to a Martial Bonus, but must still meet the weapon's Ability Requirements if any. The Weapon's TP cost can be at most 12.
op_1_desc: Increase the Rarity tier of the weapon by 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the TP maximum by 2.

name: Merged Senses
description: Merge your perception and senses with that of a willing Companion. You may temporarily replace your Acuity with the target's and can perceive through its senses, including special senses.

name: Resurrection
description: While in range of any part of a dead target, return it to life with maximum Health and any missing body parts restored, as long as the target died within the last ten years. This Power part takes 1 hour to use.
op_1_desc: Increase the time since death for this Power to work by 10 years.

name: True Resurrection
description: Speak the name of a dead target and return it to life with maximum Health and any missing body parts restored within the range of this Power, as long as the target died within the last one-hundred years. This Power part takes 1 hour to use.
op_1_desc: Increase the time since death by an additional 100 years.

name: Ward from Death
description: Target a willing creature. When the creature would gain the dying condition, they instead drop to 1 Health. This effect lasts for 8 hours, but ends when used.

name: Irreducible Max Health
description: Target cannot have its health reduced below its maximum Health, and its maximum, not current, is restored to its default if it is currently below.

name: Stasis
description: Target dead creature stops decaying completely and cannot rot any further. Any Power or feat that requires a target that has been dead for less than a certain amount of time can affect this creature as if it had only been dead for as long as it had when this Power was used. Targets affected this way cannot be raised as undead creatures.

name: Feign Death
description: Target willing creature enters a death-like state that is perceived by all means as death, other than by Powers or Feats that reveal life. While in this state, the creature has the Blind Condition and Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Spiritual for the duration and cannot gain the weakened condition.

name: Suppress Healing
description: Target cannot regain Health for the duration of the Power.

name: Permanent Damage
description: Target's maximum health is reduced by an amount equal to the damage dealt by this Power when initially used, to a minimum of 1. This effect last until Full Recovery or it is ended by other means.

name: Speed Increase
description: Increase target's Speed by +1.
op_1_desc: Increase Speed by an additional +1.

name: Grant Feat
description: Target creature gains a chosen level 1 Character Feat for which they meet the level requirement.
op_1_desc: Target gains a chosen Archetype Feat instead.
op_2_desc: Target can treat their level as double when considering added Feat level requirement.

name: Ability Increase
description: Increase one of a target's Abilities by +1 for the duration.
op_1_desc: Increase the chosen Ability by an additional +1.

name: Jump
description: Double the distance a target can jump. Immediately upon being affected by this Power, the target may choose to jump without any action.
op_1_desc: Triple, quadruple, etc., the distance a target can jump instead, for each level of this option.

name: Skill Sharpen
description: Increase a target's specified Skill Bonus by +1 for the duration.
op_1_desc: Increase this by an additional +1.

name: Ability Decrease
description: Decrease target's Ability by -1 for the duration.
op_1_desc: Increase this penalty by -1.

name: Leave No Trace
description: Target leaves no tracks, traces, or noticeable signs of presence to be tracked by natural means for the Power's duration. Any of these traces of existence that were left before this Power was used up to a time equal to the duration of this Power are also removed.

name: Remove Condition
description: End a non-leveled condition or decrease by 1 a leveled condition on a target. Target's Evasion if the target is unwilling.
op_1_desc: Increase the levels reduced from the condition by 1, or remove an additional condition.

name: Greater Restore
description: End or decrease by 1 level a Condition of your choice on the target.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of conditions you can remove, or the level by which they are reduced, by 1.

name: Value Restore
description: Target may restore any number of their values (maximum health, energy, abilities, and so on) to their normal value.

name: Enhancement
description: Add +1d4 to each Ability or Skill Roll or Score of the target's choice used during the Power's duration. Target must choose what will gain this bonus when they become affected by this Power, which remains the same throughout the Power's duration.
op_1_desc: Increase this bonus die size by +1d2.

name: Deafen
description: Target becomes Deafened. Target's Fortitude.

name: Bane
description: Apply -1d4 to a Defense, Attack type (e.g., Strength or Agility attack), Potency, or Skill of your choice used during the Power's duration. You may choose to have this affect all defenses, but end the first time it is used to lower a defense.
op_1_desc: Increase the bane die size by 1d2.

name: Reduce Target's Damage
description: Decrease the target's damage by 1d4.
op_1_desc: Increase this reduction die size by 1d2.

name: Battle Disable
description: Decrease the target's attacks by 1. Targets your choice of Fortitude, Resolve, or Mental Fortitude, which you choose upon making this Power.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of this effect by 1.

name: Shield
description: Create a 2 Health shield localized to a target, which takes damage before it would at the cost of its Health. Target applies all damage to the shield before accounting for their resistances, vulnerabilities, and reductions.
op_1_desc: Increase the shield's health by 2.
op_2_desc: Add a damage type to the shield, giving the shield Resistance to that same damage type, and vulnerability to the opposite damage type, or a different damage type specified that makes sense for the flavor.

name: Weaken
description: Target gains the Weakened 1 Condition.
op_1_desc: Increase the Weakened Condition by an additional level.

name: Decrease Critical Range
description: Decrease the target's Critical Range by 1. Targets Evasion.
op_1_desc: Reduce the target's critical range by an additional -1.

name: Weapon Damage Boost
description: Increase weapon damage dealt by the target by 1d4 of a damage type of your choice, or the damage type they deal normally.
op_1_desc: Increase the additional damage die size by +1d2.

name: Purify
description: End or remove the effects you choose from any consumables in the area of this Power, such as poisons, potions, rotten food, etc. You may specify the desired effect to remove or specify none and cause a random effect to be removed if any (i.e., purifying food from a poison, even if you're unsure there is any).

name: Darkvision
description: Target gains Darkvision out to 6 spaces.
op_1_desc: Increase the Darkvision range by 6 spaces.

name: Enlarge
description: Increase the target willing creature's Size by one level. Target's Evasion if unwilling.

name: Shrink
description: Decrease target's size by one level. Targets Evasion if unwilling.
op_1_desc: Decrease by an additional level to a minimum of minuscule.

name: Gas Form
description: Target willing creature transforms, along with anything they are wearing or holding, into a cloud of mist for the Power's duration. This Power ends early if the target's Health reaches 0 or if they use a Basic Action to end the transformation themselves. While in this mist form, the creature's only movement is a flying speed of 2 spaces. They can move through other creatures' spaces, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (but are still susceptible to damage from force or area effects). Target can only pass through spaces if those are not sealed off, but even they may pass through tight doors or gaps where they can fit. Other creatures cannot follow the target, except if they have certain abilities or specialized Powers.

name: Guided
description: Ignore the effects of one level of obscurity when targeting a creature with this Power.
op_1_desc: Ignore an additional level of Obscurity.

name: Invisible Power
description: Power is invisible; the location of its effect cannot be seen, nor can its path of travel, and so on.

name: Subtle Power Use
description: You use the Power undetected. Creatures cannot perceive that you are using a Power or are the one who used it. Creatures can roll Discernment against your Potency to attempt to perceive you as the Power user or determine that you used a/the Power.

name: Cause to Lose Focus
description: Target loses Focus. Targets any Defense of your choice other than Evasion that's already a part of the Power. If there's no other targeted Defense, this targets Mental Fortitude or Resolve.

name: End Flame
description: Power ends any flames in the affected area.

name: Flammable
description: The area or creatures your Power affects are considered flammable for the duration. If touched by fire, the area or creature becomes ignited. Ignited creatures take 1d4 fire damage each turn until an Interaction combined with a DS 10 Reflex roll as part of the Ability Roll action is made to put the fire out. If a creature enters an ignited space, they must make a Reflex Roll DS 10 or become ignited. The flames last for a duration decided by the Realm Master and can spread.

name: Relocate Power
description: As a Basic Action, you may move this Power to a new location within half its range, without affecting any creatures or objects along the path.
op_1_desc: Reduce the Action cost by 1 Action Point.
op_2_desc: Affect all creatures and objects on the path to the new location.

name: Interaction
description: You take an Interaction as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part or Power mechanic, it can be taken without any action cost.

name: Ability Roll
description: You take the Ability Roll action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part it can be used as a Free Action.

name: Evade
description: You take the evade action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part or Power mechanic, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Take the Evade action an additional time for each level of this option.

name: Brace
description: You take the Brace action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part, it can be taken as a Free action.
op_1_desc: Take the Brace action an additional time as part of this Power.

name: Focus
description: You take the Focus Action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part or Power mechanic, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Take the Focus Action an additional time as part of this Power's action.

name: Search/Detect
description: You take the Search or Detect action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action or Reaction.

name: Stealth/Hide
description: You take the Stealth/Hide Action as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Sustain this action on future turns without any Action Points for the duration of the Power. You may also switch from Stealthing to Hiding or vice versa once per turn without an Action Point cost.

name: Combination Attack
description: You take the Combination Attack Reaction as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Help
description: You take the Help Reaction as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is neither a general part nor a Power mechanic, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Defend
description: You take the Defend Reaction as part of this Power. If this is the only Power part that is not a general part or Power mechanic, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Outer Illusion
description: Outer illusions make the outside world seem different in some way (e.g., creating the appearance of a chest, person, animal, tree, etc.). An outer illusion is an inanimate illusion occupying a single target space and cannot target a creature. If a creature has reason to suspect it is an illusion, they may roll Discernment against your potency to learn it is an illusion.
op_1_desc: +1 EN & 1 TP for each additional space the illusion affects.
op_2_desc: +1 EN & 2 TP to add sound to the illusion.
op_3_desc: +2 EN & 2 TP to add both sound and animation/in-place movement.

name: Massive Outer Illusion
description: Outer illusions make the outside world seem different in some way (e.g., creating the appearance of a chest, person, animal, tree, etc.). An outer illusion is an inanimate illusion and cannot target a creature. If a creature has reason to suspect it is an illusion, they may roll Discernment against your potency to learn it is an illusion. The size of this illusion is equal to the size of the Power's effect.
op_1_desc: Add a form of audible sound that the illusion can make, such as a scratching, music, crackling, etc.
op_2_desc: The illusion can have animation while remaining within its designated space, such as a fire's movement, water falling, an insect moving around, and so on.

name: Inner Illusion
description: Inner illusions make part of the world seem different in some way (e.g., creating the appearance of a chest, person, animal, tree, etc.) to a targeted individual. You may add other Power parts to this Power at 50% their energy cost to be part of the illusion, targeting Mental Fortitude instead of the normal defense, if any. Any damage dealt is applied as Psychic after applying resistances, vulnerabilities, and reductions. If a creature has reason to suspect it is an illusion, they may roll Discernment against your potency to learn it is an illusion. The illusion is a static, unmoving image that, if interacted with, appears to the target as being real. The illusion can be up to one space in all dimensions.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of spaces of size the illusion can be by 1.
op_2_desc: Add a form of audible sound that the illusion can make, such as a scratching, music, crackling, etc.
op_3_desc: The illusion can have animation while remaining within its designated space, such as a fire's movement, water falling, an insect moving around, and so on.

name: Limited Invisibility
description: Make a willing target invisible. Targets Evasion if the target is unwilling. Invisibility ends if the target uses a Power, Technique, or takes an offensive action.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: Target gains the Invisible condition if willing. Target's Evasion if unwilling.

name: Disguise
description: Change how you look and what you appear to be wearing to others for the duration. This change cannot make you appear a size larger or smaller than your actual size. If a creature suspects you're disguised, they may roll Discernment against your potency to learn you are disguised.
op_1_desc: You may appear one size smaller or larger than you normally are. This doesn't make you any easier or more difficult to hit, targeting Evasion.

name: Blind
description: Target creature gains the Blind condition. Target's Fortitude.

name: Silence
description: The area or target creature hit becomes completely silent. Affected creatures gain the Deafened condition and cannot use Powers that require any noise to be used. No sounds created within the area by the creature can be heard, and no sound can pass through the area. Targets Fortitude if affecting targets directly.

name: See Future
description: Look 1 round into the future. All your attempts to overcome gain +3 during the time you saw into the future. Any events that are guaranteed to occur during this time are told to you by the Realm Master.
op_1_desc: See an additional turn into the future.

name: Read Mind
description: Read a target's immediate thoughts (what they are thinking about in that moment). You must roll a Power attack against a target's Discernment and succeed for them not to notice you are reading their mind. If you fail, they know you are attempting to read their mind and may roll Mental Fortitude against your potency, causing the Power to fail on success.
op_1_desc: Upon success, you learn their deeper thoughts and plans as well.
op_2_desc: Upon success, know their deepest thoughts, secrets, intents, and desires.

name: Darkness
description: Cause darkness to fill a specific area, lightly obscuring it. If cast on a light source, the light's radius decreases by 2 spaces for each level of obscurity. Light sources created by Powers instead decrease by 1 space for each level of obscurity.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of Obscurity by 1.

name: Fog
description: Create a thick cloud of Light Obscurity in this Power's area.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of Obscurity by 1.

name: Modify Memories
description: Roll a Power Attack against a target's Mental Fortitude. On a Success, you may reshape its memory of an event that took place within the last 24 hours, provided the event lasted no more than 10 minutes. You can permanently erase the memory, make the target recall it with perfect accuracy, alter the event's details, or implant a memory of a different event entirely. To modify the target's memory, you must describe the changes verbally in a language it understands. The target's mind fills in any inconsistencies in your description and doesn't know you modified its memories. The modified memories take hold as soon as this Power's duration ends. A modified memory may not necessarily change the creature's behavior, especially if it conflicts with the creature's personality, alignment, or beliefs. Illogical memories, like fondly recalling a swim in acid, are dismissed as dreams or misremembered events. The Realm Master may decide if a memory alteration is too unreasonable to influence the creature. Modified memories can be restored in a variety of ways. Targets Mental Fortitude.

name: Illusioned Power
description: This Power and its effects are entirely illusory, although they still do the same things and have the same effect on the target as if they were non-illusory. Any damage the target takes still applies Resistances and Weaknesses of the damage type, but the actual damage that is applied is Psychic. For example, if this Power deals 5 Fire damage to a creature Weak to Fire, it would take 10 Psychic damage; if it were also Resistant to Psychic, it would reduce that 10 to 5. The entire Power and its effects target your choice of Mental Fortitude or Discernment instead of any other targeted defenses. The target cannot attempt to overcome this Power and its effects until it suspects that it may be an illusion.

name: Programmed Illusion
description: When added to a Power with Illusion parts, you gain full autonomy over how the illusion acts, sounds, moves, and so on during the Power's duration, whether or not the original Illusion had these capabilities. You can program Illusion(s) created by this power to take specific, pre-determined actions for its duration, even without you being present.

name: Dream
description: You choose a creature you are familiar with in the same Realm. You or a willing creature enters a trance state to serve as a dream messenger. While in this trance, the messenger becomes unconscious. If the target is asleep, the messenger manifests in the target's dreams, allowing for conversation for the duration of the Power as long as the target remains asleep. The messenger can also shape the dream environment, creating landscapes, objects, and various images. The messenger can exit the trance at any moment, which ends the Power. The target will recall the dream in detail upon waking. If the target is awake when the Power is used, the messenger becomes aware of this and can either terminate the trance (and thus the Power) or wait for the target to fall asleep, at which point the messenger enters the target's dreams. You can choose to make the messenger appear terrifying to the target. If you do, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words targeting Resolve using your Power Bonus. On a successful Power roll, the target suffers no restorative benefits from its Recovery and takes 1d6 Psychic damage upon waking.
op_1_desc: Increase the Psychic damage dealt by 1d6.

name: Enthrall
description: Target gets -1 to Acuity Skills and Discernment when trying to perceive anything or any creature other than you, or a willing creature within range. Targets Resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase this penalty by an additional -1.

name: Compelled Duel
description: Target must overcome your Potency with Resolve each time it tries to attack a target other than you. If it fails, it may choose to use that action later in the turn to attack you instead, or it loses the action. Target's Resolve. This effect cannot be overcome with the Overcome action if the target has already attempted to attack a creature other than you in the same round.

name: Disagreeable
description: Target feels that every piece of information they encounter is wrong, and they disagree with this information. This can be an opinion, idea, fact, with any method of delivery; written, spoken, or telepathically delivered, and so on. If more than one creature interacts with another who has this effect, they continually argue for the duration of the Power or until something causes them to stop interacting in this way, such as a higher priority, threat, etc. Target's Resolve.

name: Disorient
description: Target believes the direction it's going is either the correct direction for its desired goal or the opposite direction of its desired goal. If the creature can see the place they are desiring to go, they gain +10 on the defense roll to overcome this effect. Targets Discernment or Resolve.

name: Nondetection
description: Target cannot be the target of any Power that would attempt to locate, or remotely see or perceive the target in any way, for this Power's duration. If they are already being detected in this way, the detection stops, and any Powers detecting them this way end.

name: Body Swap
description: You become the target creature, and the target creature becomes you, each taking the physical body and location of the other. You retain all mental abilities, but temporarily replace your physical Abilities, Defenses, Speed, Evasion, physically related Traits, and current/maximum health with the target's. You do not gain any of the target's proficiencies, and each of your items worn and carried remains on your body and does not travel with you to your new form. The same conditions apply to the creature in your form. You may still use Powers and Techniques known to you, provided your new form allows it. You may choose to return to your form as a Free Action. Target's your choice of Mental Fortitude or Resolve.

name: Take-Over
description: You gain control over 1 of the target creature's Action Points and may, as a Reaction at the start of that creature's turn, spend an equal amount of your own Action Points to force the creature to take a specific action. The action you cause them to take can be any action that the creature is capable of performing that they know of. The affected creature uses its remaining Action Points first, before you use the controlled Action Point(s) to act. You cannot utilize controlled Action Points if it would prevent the target from at least having 1 Action Point to act. Targets Resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the controlled Action Points by 1, to a maximum of 3 Action Points in total.

name: Compelling Sight
description: After the initial use of the Power causes a target to be affected, that target cannot attempt to overcome this Power's effect while they remain within the range of this Power and in line of sight of you or a creature you chose within range. This does not affect a creature that does not have sight.

name: Suggest
description: You propose a course of action, explained in no more than 25 words, to a creature within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must seem reasonable and cannot involve anything that would harm the target or its allies. For example, you might say, "Retrieve the book about the evil-doers' activities vault and hand it to me," or "Cease fighting, leave this town peacefully, and do not come back." This course of action is taken for the duration of this Power or until you or your allies cause the target harm. The target follows the suggestion to the best of its ability. If the suggested action is completed, the Power ends. Targets Resolve.

name: Compelled Movement
description: Target must spend 1 action point on its turn to move away from or towards you in the quickest and safest route possible. Target's Resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of action points spent on movement by one to a maximum of 3.
op_2_desc: Force the creature to spend these action point(s) (if any) as a reaction, moving immediately instead. If the creature doesn't have action points to spend on reactionary movement, they must spend as many as they can now, then spend the rest as a reaction when they regain action points.

name: Mind Break
description: At the start of the target's turn, they must roll Resolve against your potency. Every failure results in that creature losing an Action Point to a minimum of 1 remaining Action Point, while overcoming ends the Power. Targets Resolve.

name: Shift Focus
description: Target has a -1 penalty on all attacks made against you or another specified target for the duration. Targets Resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase this penalty by -1.

name: Curse
description: Target has -2 to the Defense and Skill rolls of one Ability of your choice when you use this Power. Targets Mental Fortitude, Resolve, or Fortitude.
op_1_desc: Increase the penalty by an additional -1.
op_2_desc: This effect now also reduces the Defense and Skill Scores of the chosen ability.

name: Communicate
description: Gain the ability to communicate with animals, non-sentient creatures, or plants, being able to understand them, and them you.

name: De-motivate
description: Target gains the Weakened 1 condition, but only whenever attempting to pursue the course of action they were taking or planning on taking when this Power was used. Targets Resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the Weakened condition by 1.

name: Escalate
description: Any emotion the target currently feels is heightened, targeting Resolve. Example: If the target is feeling angry at someone or something, their anger is escalated to a level that might become violent. If the emotional effect is from a Power, any values connected to that effect, such as frightened condition levels, are doubled.

name: Aggravate
description: Target becomes aggravated or more aggravated at a target of your choice that they can see for a round. Aggravated targets want to destroy the target they are aggravated at. If the target is someone with whom they are allied, they gain a +8 bonus to their resolve to overcome this effect. Targets resolve.
op_1_desc: Decrease the overcome roll bonus by 1 for a target that is allied to the target you desire for them to become aggravated at.
op_2_desc: Cause the target to be angered towards any nearby target indiscriminately without granting a bonus to Resolve instead.

name: Friends
description: Target, which considers you non-hostile, now considers you friendly. If the target Overcomes this Power, they are aware that you used a Power to try and influence them, provided their intelligence is above -4. Target's Resolve.
op_1_desc: If a target overcomes this Power, they remain unaware that you attempted to influence them.

name: Indifference
description: Target becomes indifferent toward creatures it was hostile toward previously. This indifference ends when any hostile action is taken toward the target, or its allies, from said creatures or their allies, or whenever the target takes damage. When the Power ends, the target's attitude returns to what it was when the Power was used. Target's resolve.

name: Charm
description: Target gains the Charmed condition, being Charmed by you. If the target is hostile toward you, they gain +8 to their resolve to resist this effect. Targets resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of creatures the target can be charmed by by 1.
op_2_desc: Decrease the Resolve bonus for creatures hostile to you by 1.

name: Immune to Take-Over
description: Target is immune to having its actions or movement controlled or decided by another entity. If the target is already being affected in this way, that effect ends immediately.

name: Interaction
description: You take an Interaction as part of this Technique. If this is the only part, it can be taken without any action cost.

name: Ability Roll
description: You take the Ability Roll action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part, it can be used as a Free Action.

name: Frighten
description: Target gains the Frightened 1 Condition. Targets resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of Frigthened by 1.

name: Mark Creature
description: Whenever you deal damage to the target creature, you may add 1d4 to that damage. Targets resolve.
op_1_desc: Increase the added damage die size by 1d2.

name: Command Movement
description: You choose how a target uses 1 Action Point worth of the Movement Action or Interaction as long as it's not directly harmful to itself or allies, such as making a target run off a cliff. The target uses this action immediately as a Movement Reaction. Targets your choice of Resolve or Mental Fortitude.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of controlled Action Points of Movement/Interaction to a maximum of 3.

name: Wall
description: Create a wall that is up to one space long/tall and a half meter wide. The wall counts as an object and has 5 Health, and cannot be critically hit. Each space of the wall has its own Health. The wall can be shaped however you'd like with its provided amount of spaces, including in a rounded shape. If the wall is created in the same space as a creature, the creature must roll Reflex against your Potency or be placed on a side of the wall that you choose. If they succeed, they may choose which side to end up on. If this Power deals damage, it is only dealt if the creature fails this save or somehow traverses a space of the wall (including through breaking it and moving through its space before the damage duration ends).
op_1_desc: Increase the Health of wall segments by 2.
op_2_desc: Add 1 space to the wall's length.

name: Block
description: Block an attack by making a Power roll and treating the result as your new Evasion for the attack.

name: Damage Reduction
description: Reduce damage dealt to the target by 1 using the same rules as equipped armor, except it reduces damage dealt regardless of damage type.
op_1_desc: Increase the Damage Reduction by 1 to a maximum of 8.
op_2_desc: Increase the allowed damage reduction maximum by 1.

name: Brace
description: You take the Brace Action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part, it can be taken as a Free action.
op_1_desc: Take the Brace action an additional time as part of this Technique.

name: Deflect
description: When you are the target of a Power, you may choose a new target for the Power, using your Power attack roll and a target up to half the range of the original Power. The Energy cost of the deflected Power must be equal to or less than the amount decided by this Part's option 1 level of increase (decided upon Power Creation).
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of energy that can be deflected by 2.

name: Counter
description: Target Power, with Energy equal to or less than the Energy range decided by this Power in range, ends immediately.
op_1_desc: Increase the range of Energy this Power can end on a Power by 2 Energy.

name: Absorb
description: Absorb Energy from target Power. Every 2 Energy the user paid for that Power costs +1.5 Energy to absorb, which you pay upon using this Power in addition to its base cost, ending or canceling the Power if you absorb all of its Energy. If you're unable to pay the full cost of the Power to absorb, you absorb up to the amount you have, but the Power still takes effect. If the Power deals damage, you may reduce that damage by 1 for every 2 Energy absorbed. You gain all absorbed Energy at the start of the next turn or 10 seconds, whichever comes sooner.

name: Negate Power
description: Cancel target Power in range as it is used (not after the fact). The Energy cost of the ended Power must be equal to or less than the amount decided by this Part's option 1 level of increase (decided upon Power Creation).
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of energy that can be canceled by 2.

name: End Power's Effect
description: Target a Power that has already been used, and has a duration longer than one round, in an attempt to end that Power. If the Power you're attempting to end has more Energy cost than you can end with this part, you can instead attempt a Power roll against it in an attempt to end it, with a DS equal to 10 +1 for each 5 Energy that the Power costs above what this part can end. This part can end a Power with an Energy cost equal to or less than decided by this Part's option 1 level.
op_1_desc: Increase the Energy maximum of Power's this Power can end by 2.

name: Power Ward
description: No Powers can be used in or pass through the area while this Power occupies it. Any magical items become mundane while they occupy the same space as this Power. Any Power that is active or exists in the area of this Power immediately ends.

name: Blessed
description: Target gains a 1d4 Bonus to Overcome Scores when rolling, such as with Attacks and Skill rolls. They gain this same Bonus to their Scores and Defenses when they would be targeted, except for Evasion.
op_1_desc: Increase the Bonus die size by 1d2.

name: Resistance
description: Target creature gains Resistance to a specified Damage type for the duration.
op_1_desc: Grant a Resistance to an additional Damage type.

name: Minor Resistance
description: Once each turn, when you take a chosen non-physical damage type, you reduce that damage by 1d4.
op_1_desc: Increase this die size by 1d2.

name: Evasion Increase
description: Increase the target's Evasion by +1.
op_1_desc: Increase Evasion by an additional +1.

name: Ward
description: Target has -1 to Overcome your Scores. Targets your choice of Resolve, Mental Fortitude, or Discernment.
op_1_desc: Increase this penalty by -1.

name: Sanctuary
description: For the duration, when a creature attempts to target the target affected by this Power with an offensive attack or effect, they must first roll Resolve against your Power Potency, and upon failure, choose a new target or lose the action.

name: Condition Resistance
description: Target gains +1 to overcome a specified condition chosen upon Power creation.
op_1_desc: Increase this bonus by 1.

name: Condition Immunity
description: Target gains immunity to a specified Condition. If they already have the Condition, they lose it.
op_1_desc: Add an additional Condition Immunity.

name: Connected Health
description: A willing target is connected to you. Whenever it would take damage, it takes half of that damage, and you take the other half (after applying that target's resistances and damage reduction[s]).
op_1_desc: Target's 1 unwilling creature and 1 willing creature. Whenever the willing creature would take damage, it takes half of that damage, and the unwilling creature takes the other half (after applying the willing target's resistances and damage reduction[s]).

name: Impassible Aura
description: No creature can enter or exit the Area of Effect of this Power for the Power's duration. As a Free Action, you may choose to move the area being affected by this power to another point within range. If the area is moved to occupy the same space as a creature, then this Power ends.

name: Power Resistance
description: Target gains +1 to overcome any Power that targets them or is affecting them.
op_1_desc: Increase this resistance by +1.

name: Power Damage Resistance
description: Target gains resistance to all damage dealt by Powers.

name: Fall Resistance
description: Reduce the target's fall damage by 1/2.
op_1_desc: Reduce fall damage to 0 instead.

name: Cylinder of Effect
description: 25% EN: Add a cylinder of effect with a 1-space radius and a 2 space height centered on yourself or a point within range that you can see. The power affects all targets within this area. Roll one attack against all targets' relevant defense.
op_1_desc: 25% EN: Increase the radius by +1 or to increase the height by 4.

name: Sphere of Effect
description: 25% EN: Add a sphere of effect with a 1-space radius centered on yourself or a point within range that you can see. The power affects all targets within this area. Roll one attack against all targets' relevant defense.
op_1_desc: 25% EN: Increase the radius by +1.

name: Trail of Effect
description: 25% EN: Each space directly between you and this Power's target is affected for the Power's duration. A creature that begins its turn in one of these spaces must roll the relevant defense against your potency or become affected.

name: Pierce Targets on Path
description: Each object occupying a space between you and the Power's target takes 1d2 magic damage.
op_1_desc: #ERROR!

name: Add Multiple Targets
description: Target an additional creature within range. Make one or multiple attack rolls however you choose, but only one damage roll, applying it to both targets, splitting the total damage between them. Any other power effects only target one of the chosen creatures.
op_1_desc: +1 EN For each additional target.

name: Expanding Area of Effect
description: 50% EN: At the end of your turn after the round in which Power was used, its area of effect increases 1 space in all directions.

name: Target One in an Area of Effect
description: -25% EN: When you first use this Power and at the beginning of the turn the Power was used, you can choose one creature within its area of effect to target with the Power. The Power can only target and affect creatures in this way. You don't need to see a target to make it the target of the Power. Can only be applied to Powers with Area of Effect greater than one space

name: Exclude Area
description: You may choose to exclude certain parts within an area of effect of this Power from being affected.

name: True Magic Damage
description: Add +1 magic damage to the Power. Targets evasion by default.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN for each additional +1 magic damage.

name: True Light Damage
description: Add +1 light damage to the Power. Targets fortitude by default.
op_1_desc: +1.5 EN for each additional +1 light damage.

name: True Physical Damage
description: Add one physical damage type to your Power (Piercing, Slashing, or Bludgeoning). This adds +1 of that type to the Power's damage. +1.5 EN for each additional 1 damage of this type dealt. +2 EN, +1 TP to apply more than one of these damage types to the Power (this cost does not increase the damage). Targets evasion.
op_1_desc: +1.5 EN for each additional +1 damage of this type.
op_2_desc: 2 EN, +1 TP to apply more than one of these damage types to the Power (this cost does not increase the damage).

name: True Elemental Damage
description: Add +1 elemental damage type to your Power (Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Acid). This automatically adds +1 to the Power's damage. +1.5 EN for each additional 1 damage of this type dealt. +2 EN, +1 TP to apply more than one element to the Power (this cost does not increase the damage). Targets evasion.
op_1_desc: +1.5 EN for each additional +1 damage of this type.
op_2_desc: 2 EN, +1 TP to apply more than one element to the Power (this cost does not increase the damage).

name: True Poison or Necrotic Damage
description: Add 1 Poison or Necrotic damage targeting fortitude. +1.5 EN per each additional +1 damage of that type.
op_1_desc: +1.5 EN per each additional +1 damage of that type.

name: True Sonic Damage
description: Add 1 Sonic damage targeting fortitude. +2 EN per each additional +1 sonic damage.
op_1_desc: +2 EN per each additional +1 sonic damage.

name: True Spiritual Damage
description: Add 1 Spiritual damage targeting resolve. +2 EN per each additional +1 spiritual damage.
op_1_desc: +2 EN per each additional +1 spiritual damage.

name: True Psychic Damage
description: Add 1 Psychic damage targeting mental fortitude. +2 EN per each additional +1 psychic damage.
op_1_desc: +2 EN per each additional +1 psychic damage.

name: Controlled Damage
description: Split damage into additional dice of the same value.
op_1_desc: Increase this option for every additional die added.

name: Long-Linger Damage
description: Choose a damage type. Each round, the creature takes 1d4 damage of that type for at the beginning of each turn for the duration. Targets Fortitude for all damage types except Psychic, which targets Mental Fortitude. This part cannot have a duration of less than 2 rounds.
op_1_desc: Increase the damage die size by +1d2.

name: Siphon
description: Choose a damage type when making this power; the target loses 1d4 Health, energy, or both as that damage. You decide how much to drain from each resource (Health/Energy) after rolling and accounting for reductions, resistances & weaknesses. If one resource is insufficient, the siphon automatically draws from the other. At the end of the turn, you regain Health and/or Energy equal to what was siphoned, with siphoned Energy giving you Energy, and Health giving you Health. The maximum combined Health/Energy you can gain from this is 10. This part cannot have a duration of more than 1 round. Targets Fortitude. You do not add your Power Attack Bonus to this Power's damage, and the damage is reduced by armor, no matter the type.
op_1_desc: Increase this damage die size by 1d2.

name: Damage Siphon
description: When you damage a creature, you heal or regain energy at the end of the turn, equal to half the damage dealt (up to 10 points of Health and/or Energy regained). This part cannot have a duration of more than one round.
op_1_desc: Increase the maximum Health/Energy regained by +2.

name: Power Infused Weapon
description: Add your Power Bonus to the attack and damage rolls you make with a melee or ranged weapon that is part of this Power. You must be proficient with that weapon.

name: Mend
description: Repair a single break or tear in an object, like a broken chain link, two halves of a shattered key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 30 centimeters in any dimension, you mend it seamlessly, leaving no trace of the prior damage. This can physically restore a damaged enhanced item, but cannot reinstate any lost enhanced properties.

name: Minorly Manipulate Air
description: You generate a breeze strong enough to ripple fabric, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all within a one-space cube. Doors and shutters that are held open by a person or object remain unaffected.

name: Minorly Manipulate Earth
description: You create a thin layer of dust or sand that spreads over surfaces in a one-space cube, or you inscribe a single word in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

name: Minorly Manipulate Water
description: You conjure a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects within a one-space cube. Alternatively, you create one cup of clean water, either in an open container or on a surface, which evaporates after 1 minute.

name: Minorly Manipulate Fire
description: You produce a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke within a one-space cube. You determine the color and scent, and the embers can ignite candles, torches, or lamps in the area. The smoke's fragrance lingers for the Power's Duration.

name: Minorly Manipulate Elements
description: You shape dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit within a 30-centimeter cube into a crude form (such as that of a creature), which holds its shape for this Power's Duration.

name: Tremors
description: The ground vibrates harmlessly in a rhythm or continuously, as you choose, within the entire range of the Power for the duration.

name: Invisible Force
description: You instantly cause an unsecured door or window to burst open or slam shut, or another harmless effect, briefly manipulating a movable unsecured object.

name: Detached Sound
