description: Create a sound that is localized at a point within range such as ominous voices, a birds crow, or the distant sound of thunder.

name: Booming Voice
description: Your voice amplifies up to three times its normal volume. During this time, you gain +1 on Intimidation and other thematically appropriate rolls.
op_1_desc: Increase this roll bonus by an additional +1.

name: Altered Eyes
description: Alter the color or appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.

name: Flavor
description: Give a normal or somewhat unique flavor to up to one cubic half meter of food or liquid for the duration. Increasing this Power's area allows it to affect each food or drink of your choice within that area.

name: Fire Manipulation
description: You instantly ignite or extinguish a small flammable object such as a candle, torch, or small campfire.

name: Plant Manipulation
description: Slightly manipulate a plant by causing it to bud, bloom, grow a centimeter, wither slightly, change flower color to a different flower color, or change leaf color to match a different season, and so on. This manipulation is permanent.

name: Chill or Warm
description: Warm or chill up to one cubic half meter of material, food, or liquid.

name: Mark
description: You cause a color, a small mark, or a symbol to manifest on an object or surface, taking up no more than half a square meter for the Power's duration.

name: Clean or Soil
description: Instantly clean or soil an area no larger than half a cubic meter.
op_1_desc: Increase this area by half a cubic meter. Once this option is used to the point of increasing this area to one and a half cubic meters, you must increase its Area of Effect using the Area of Effect mechanics instead.

name: Sensory Effect
description: Create a harmless sensory effect, such as cascading leaves, ethereal dancing fairies, a soft breeze, the sound of an animal, a faint scent, soft musical notes, or another noise. The effect must fit within a 1-space cube.

name: Tiny Creation
description: You conjure a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. A trinket cannot deal damage and has no monetary value. It remains in existence for the duration.

name: Weather Sense
description: You know what the weather will be like within the next 24 hours within 5 kilometers.

name: Understand Language
description: Understand all written and audible languages for the duration.

name: Tongues
description: Gain proficiency in a chosen language for the duration, allowing you to speak and understand it, both written and oral.

name: Light
description: Add bright light out to 2 spaces, with an additional 2 spaces of dim light. Bright light is considered unobscured, while dim light is lightly obscured for creatures relying on sight. If this is the only Power part, the light lasts for 1 minute. The light can linger on a person, object, or in range in the air depending on the Power.
op_1_desc: +1 EN to increase bright and dim light by 2 spaces each.

name: Thought
description: Add a simple thought, idea, or memory to the Power. Conditions for receiving or understanding this idea are set upon Power creation. A thought not delivered to a target can take a physical form to signify its presence in an area, remaining until a Full Recovery. This form cannot be larger than a one-space flat surface.
op_1_desc: Increase the space it can occupy to one cubic space or 1 additional space of flat surface.

name: Distant Message
description: Send an audible message of up to 6 seconds to a creature that you are aware of. Only that creature can hear the message. The creature can choose to block this Power's ability to send them messages after they receive the first message. Creatures who do this cannot be contacted this way until they've had a Full Recovery or choose to allow messages.

name: Breathe
description: Target can breathe normally despite an environmental factor that would prevent it (e.g., underwater, a realm without air, or a water-breathing-only creature without water). You must choose the environmental factor when creating the Power.

name: Ping
description: For the duration of this Power, you receive acute awareness immediately whenever a specified event within the area of this Power occurs (e.g., a rune being touched, a thought being received or read, a creature entering an area, or a creature succeeding/failing a potency roll from your Power).

name: Audio
description: Add a sound to your Power. This sound can only cause damage if Sonic damage is added. The sound is audible within a 6-space radius.
op_1_desc: +0.5 EN for each additional 3 spaces of audition.

name: Create Food
description: Create enough rations for 1 creature to avoid malnutrition for a day. The rations are bland, but look how you'd like them to. The food spoils if uneaten in 24 hours, but remains in existence. This food has no currency value.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of rations created this way by 1.

name: Create Water
description: Create up to 5 liters of clean water, enough to avoid dehydration for 1 creature for one day. 5 liters of water can wet a creature or surface that occupies 1 space. If you attempt to douse an unwilling creature, you target its Reflex. The water created acts as normal water and does not go away when this Power ends.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of water created by 5 liters.

name: Destroy Water
description: Destroy up to 5 liters of water. 5 liters of water can wet a creature or surface that occupies 1 space.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount of destroyed water by an additional 5 liters.

name: Create Object
description: Create a tiny, mundane object worth nothing that can have a small or no effect or usefulness. It does not disappear when the power ends.
op_1_desc: Increase the currency worth of the object by 1.
op_2_desc: Increase the size of the object by 1.

name: Contact Divine
description: Contact a divine being, it's servants, or another Powerful and knowledgeable being who is revered. The being must truthfully answer one question to the best of it's knowledge about events that will transpire in the next 7 days and things relating to those events. If you use a Power with this Part again before you've finished a Full Recovery, you have a 25% chance of the Power failing, losing the resources spent to use it (roll D100, 25 or under being failure). Each time you use one of these Powers this way, the chance of failure increases by 25%.

name: Commune with Divine
description: Contact a divine being, its servants, or another powerful and knowledgeable being who is revered. The being must truthfully answer one question to the best of its knowledge, using yes or no only, or a short answer instead if that isn't clear enough. If you use a Power with this Part again before you've finished a Full Recovery, you have a 25% chance of the Power failing, losing the resources spent to use it (roll D100, 25 or under being failure). Each time you use one of these Powers this way, the chance of failure increases by 25%.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of questions you may ask this way by 1.

name: Commune with Nature
description: You commune with the natural world around you, gathering information from plants and animals, which grant you knowledge about the surrounding 100 meters of landscape, including bodies of water, settlements, ruins, common wildlife, uncommon creatures in the area, and so on.
op_1_desc: Increase the area of this effect by 100 additional meters.

name: Contact Other Realm
description: You contact a knowledgeable entity from another Realm. The being must truthfully answer one question to the best of its knowledge, using yes or no or a short answer if that isn't clear. If you use a Power with this Part again before you've finished a Full Recovery, you have a 25% chance of the Power failing, losing the resources spent to use it (roll D100, 25 or under being failure). Each time you use one of these Powers this way, the chance of failure increases by 25%.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of questions you may ask this way by 1, to a maximum of 3.

name: Legend Knowledge
description: Name or describe a well-known figure, location, or artifact. You gain a concise recounting of key lore associated with the chosen entity. The lore shared may include noteworthy facts, humorous insights, or even hidden knowledge unknown to most. The precision of the information received aligns with your prior knowledge: the more you know, the richer and more specific the lore. While the information is truthful, it may be veiled in metaphor or conveyed through poetic language. If the chosen figure, location, or artifact is not widely recognized, this Power has no effect.

name: True Telepathy
description: You link your mind with a willing creature with which you are familiar, who is on the same realm as you. You and the target can share with each other words, images, sensory information, and so on without any action cost. The Power ends if you aren't in the same realm. This part cannot have a duration of less than 12 hours.

name: Foresight
description: Target gains +1 to all Rolls and Scores to Overcome.
op_1_desc: Increase this Bonus by +1.

name: Noisy
description: Upon use and for the duration, this Power can be heard from anywhere within 30 meters.
op_1_desc: Increase the range of audition by an additional 30 meters to a maximum of 150 meters.

name: Disintegrate
description: If this Power were to kill a creature, it would be turned to dust instead. If it would damage an object, it turns any fractured off portions into dust.

name: Create Passage
description: A passage appears on a visible surface made of wood, plaster, stone, or other building material (such as a wall, ceiling, or floor) within range and lasts for the duration. You determine the dimensions of the opening: up to 1.5 meters wide, 2.5 meters tall, and 6 meters deep. The passage does not cause instability in the surrounding structure. When the passage vanishes, any creatures or objects remaining within it are safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the surface where it was.

name: Magic Damage
description: Add +1d4 magic damage to the Power. Targets evasion by default.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional 1d2 magic damage.

name: Light Damage
description: Add +1d4 light damage to the Power. Targets fortitude by default.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional +1d2 light damage.

name: Physical Damage
description: Add +1d4 physical damage type to your Power (Piercing, Slashing, or Bludgeoning). Targets evasion.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional +1d2 damage of this type.

name: Elemental Damage
description: Add +1d4 elemental damage type to your Power (Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Acid). Targets evasion.
op_1_desc: 1 EN for each additional +1d2 damage of this type.

name: Poison or Necrotic Damage
description: Add +1d4 Poison or Necrotic damage targeting fortitude.
op_1_desc: 1 EN per each additional +1d2 damage of that type.

name: Sonic Damage
description: Add +1d4 Sonic damage targeting fortitude.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN per each additional +1d2 sonic damage.

name: Spiritual Damage
description: Add +1d4 Spiritual damage targeting resolve.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN per each additional +1d2 spiritual damage.

name: Psychic Damage
description: Add +1d4 Psychic damage targeting mental fortitude.
op_1_desc: 1.5 EN per each additional +1d2 psychic damage.

name: Duration Ends On Activation
description: -50% EN from the cost of duration if the power duration ends once it first takes effect (it can be used once as normal during the duration, but ends immediately upon activation.)

name: No Harm or Adaptation for Duration
description: -50% EN from the cost of duration if the power has no offensive utility or adaptation parts.

name: Focus for Duration
description: -50% EN from the cost of duration, must spend Focus for the duration of the Power, or the Power ends.

name: Sustain for Duration
description: -25% EN from the cost of duration, must spend 1 Action Point before the end of your turn or the duration ends.
op_1_desc: -12.5% EN additional from the cost of duration for each additional Action Point required to be spend before the end of your turn or the duration ends.

name: Duration (Permanent)
description: 2500% EN This power's duration is permanent and doesn't end unless countered.

name: Heal
description: Heal target for 1d4.
op_1_desc: Increase the die size for the amount Healed by 1d2.

name: True Heal
description: Heal target for 1.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount the target is healed by 1.

name: Overheal
description: Heal target for 1d4. This healing can exceed the target’s health maximum. The health maximum doesn't increase, but allows the creature to have additional Health until they lose it. Health maximum resets after any recovery.
op_1_desc: Increase the Overheal die size by 1d2.

name: True Overheal
description: Overheal target for 1. This healing can exceed the target’s health maximum. The health maximum doesn't increase, but allows the creature to have additional Health until they lose it. Health maximum resets after any recovery.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount Overhealed by 1.

name: Major Heal
description: Heal target for 25 Health.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount healed by 5.

name: Massive Heal
description: Target Heals 80.
op_1_desc: Increase the amount Healed by 10.

name: Healing Boost
description: Target creature regains the maximum number of Health possible whenever it receives any Healing. This Part's duration starts on the turn after this.

name: Death Defying
description: When in the Dying Condition, the target's Dying damage die size never increases.

name: Terminal Heal
description: Target creature with the Dying or Terminal condition Heals 1d4 Health.
op_1_desc: Increase the Healing die size by 1d2.

name: Stabilize
description: Target creature that is in the Dying condition returns to 0 Health and is Stabilized, preventing taking more Dying damage, though it remains in the Dying condition.

name: Regenerate
description: Target creature's chosen missing body part regenerates over the next 24-hour period. During this time, it cannot be used. If the creature dies before the body part has regenerated, this Power ends, leaving the limb partially regenerated, unless the target was already dead when this Power was used.

name: Revive
description: Restore a dead target to 1 Health, as long as it died within the last round and has all vital body parts.
op_1_desc: Increase the time since death for this Power to work by 1 round.

name: Restore to Life
description: Restore a dead target to 1 Health, as long as it died within the last day and has all vital body parts. Target loses all conditions it had before death. The target raised to life gains one level of exhaustion for every day the target was dead, to a maximum exhaustion of 5 from this Power.
op_1_desc: Increase the time since death for this Power to work by 1 day.

name: Form Life
description: Cause a part of a dead target and form a new body of a random species to which you have access, as long as the target died within the last day. They replace all species traits on their character sheet with the new species, including flaws, ancestries, and characteristics chosen at random. Roll 1d4, and on odd results, add a flaw and additional ancestry; otherwise, do not add a flaw. The creature retains all feats, Powers, Techniques, and knowledge, even if these do not work with their new species/size. This Power part takes 1 hour to use.
op_1_desc: Increase the length for which a creature may have been dead while still using this Power by one day.

name: Become Wind
description: Target becomes a gaseous form, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a target has a Fly Speed of 60 spaces. It is Immune to the Prone condition and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. The only Actions target can take in this form is the Movement Action or a Basic Action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned 3 Condition. Until the Power ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Basic action followed by a 1-minute transformation. If a target is in gaseous form and flying when the effect ends, the target descends 12 spaces per round for 1 minute until it lands safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, it falls the remaining distance.

name: Manipulate Earth
description: You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area of this Power in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area’s elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can’t exceed half the area’s largest dimension. For example, if you affect a 3-space diameter sphere, you can create a pillar up to 2 spaces high, raise or lower the square’s elevation by up to 2 spaces, dig a trench up to 2 spaces deep, and so on. It takes 10 minutes for these changes to complete, but they can occur after the Power's duration ends, provided you made the change before the Power ended. Because the terrain’s transformation occurs gradually, creatures in the area cannot usually be trapped or injured by the ground’s movement. It costs a Free Action to choose where to manipulate and how, which you can change, or you can choose a new area of terrain to affect within range, during the Power's duration as a Free Action. This Power can’t manipulate natural stone or stone construction. Rocks and structures shift to accommodate the new terrain. If the way you shape the terrain would make a structure unstable, it might collapse. Similarly, this Power doesn't directly affect plant growth. The moving earth carries any plants along with it.

name: Knock Prone
description: Knock the target prone. Target's the target's choice of Might or Reflexes.

name: Controlling Summon
description: Summon or create a Tiny seen or unseen hand, creature, or other specter that can manipulate the world in small ways. This summon can move up to the range of this Power away from you, vanishing if it's ever further. It can manipulate the world in small ways, taking only Interaction and Movement actions, and is only able to hold up to 5 kilograms of mass. It has 1 Health and 3 speed.

name: Escape
description: Target is released from any mundane restraints and cannot be grappled. If the target is already grappled, it is no longer grappled.

name: Create Difficult Terrain
description: The area affected by the Power is considered Difficult Terrain for creatures on the ground.
op_1_desc: The Difficult Terrain effect applies to the entire area affected, not just the ground.

name: Ignore Difficult Terrain
description: Target ignores the effects of Difficult Terrain.

name: Scaled Slowing
description: Decrease the target's Speed by half. Targets the target's choice of Might, Evasion, or Reflexes.
op_1_desc: Decrease the target's Speed by three-fourths instead.

name: Slow
description: Target gains the Slowed 1 condition. Targets Might, Evasion, or Reflexes.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the Slowed Condition by 1.

name: Unlock
description: Unlock one minor, uncomplex lock (e.g., simple boxes, wooden doors, DS 10 or below).
op_1_desc: Instead, unlock small, slightly harder locks (e.g., wooden chests, safer doors, etc., DS 15 or below).
op_2_desc: Instead, unlock hard, more complex locks (e.g., metal doors, stronger chests, complex boxes, etc., DS 20 or below).
op_3_desc: Increase the unlockable DS by an additional +5 after increasing it to DS 20 first, using option 2.

name: Lock
description: Lock something that can be locked, such as a door, chest, window, and so on. The DS for this lock is equal to your potency and lasts until unlocked.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport target willing creature to a location that you can see within 4 spaces of that target. Targets Might if unwilling. On success, the target is teleported to a safe location without immediate danger.
op_1_desc: Increase the range of this teleport by 4 spaces.
op_2_desc: Allows enemy teleportation to any location, dangerous or not.

name: Combination Attack
description: You take the Combination Attack Reaction as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Advanced Teleport
description: Teleport to a location that you can or cannot see within the range of this Power by describing exactly where you'd like to appear, such as '10 spaces north and 2 spaces upwards' or simply by teleporting to a seen location instead. If you accidentally teleport into a location that is completely occupied, you take 4d10 irreducible damage and appear at the closest unoccupied space instead, having the Realm Master choose if they're equal distance.
op_1_desc: Teleport a distance equal to double the base range of this Power instead.

name: Long Distance Teleport
description: Teleport to a location that you have been to that is within 300 kilometers. If this Power is used to teleport a target from the same two locations 10 times within a month, then the effects of the Power are permanent and allow any creature that the Power user specifies to teleport between the locations without energy cost.
op_1_desc: Increase this range to 800 kilometers.
op_2_desc: Remove a distance limitation, allowing you to teleport to any location you've visited instead.

name: Swap
description: Switch places with an object or creature within range that weighs less than you. Swapping with an unwilling creature targets Might. If swapping with a moving object, the object continues moving in the same direction after the swap, traveling the remaining distance it would have gone.

name: Move Target
description: Move target 1 space in any direction relative to you (i.e., knock target away from you, pull closer, or force left), the direction chosen upon Power creation. The amount moved decreases by 1 for each size above medium a creature or object is, or increases by 1 for each size below medium. Targets Might. This movement is stopped by objects, walls, and so on.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of spaces the target is moved by one.
op_2_desc: Allow choosing the direction of movement upon use of Power instead of Power creation.

name: Propel
description: Willing target moves 1 space in any direction (chosen by user, and alterable by target each subsequent turn if the Power lasts multiple rounds). This movement is stopped by objects, walls, and so on.
op_1_desc: Increase the number of spaces moved by 1.

name: Daze
description: Target gains the Dazed Condition for the Power's duration. Targets Fortitude.

name: Restrained
description: Target becomes Restrained for duration. Targets Might.

name: Stun
description: Target becomes Stunned 1. Targets Fortitude.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of the Stunned condition by 1.

name: Grapple
description: Target becomes Grappled by you if they are within 1 space. Targets the target's choice of Reflexes or Might.

name: Control
description: Control a physical object that weighs up to 200 kgs within range and sight. The object can be levitated, thrown, or moved. It can only be moved as far as the Power's range. Thrown objects do 1d4 damage upon hit, but with no damage bonus, and can be thrown to a range equal to the Power's base range. If an object is already a weapon that can be thrown, it deals thrown weapon damage. Targets Might or Reflex.
op_1_desc: Increase the possible weight to control by an additional 200 kgs.
op_2_desc: Increase the number of objects able to be controlled within range by 1. The total weight you can control is the sum of all objects controlled.
op_3_desc: Add your Power Bonus to the damage dealt by thrown controlled objects. Increase this damage by a 1d2 die size for each level of this option.

name: Suspend
description: Suspend a target object you hit in its current position within range (e.g., in the air, on the ground, etc.). The object remains suspended for the round. You can release the suspension as a Quick Reaction or Action; it then continues on its original path, if any. If you suspend a ranged attack or object, you must roll to hit it, with an Evasion to hit equal to the roll-to-hit of the target throwing or shooting that object. If it is a falling object, the Difficulty Score is 12.

name: Chance of Failure
description: If you use a Power with this mechanic again before you've finished a Full Recovery, you have a 25% chance of the Power failing, losing the resources spent to use it (roll D100, 25 or under being failure). Each time you use one of these Powers this way, the chance of failure increases by 25%.

name: Forbiddance
description: Ward an area from any form of magical travel, such as teleporting in or out. Teleportation can still occur within the area. The area a 30-meter radius centered on a point you can see.
op_1_desc: Increase this radius by 30 meters.

name: Fly
description: You gain a Flying Speed of 3 Spaces.
op_1_desc: Increase this speed by 3.

name: Climbing
description: Target gains a Climb Speed equal to one-half of its Speed. They can climb vertical surfaces only.
op_1_desc: Cause this to be equal to the target's full Speed instead.
op_2_desc: Allow climbing on horizontal surfaces, even upside down.

name: Vanish from Realm
description: Vanish from this realm and appear in a safe and temporary demi-realm where you cannot see or hear anything. You reappear in the same location from which you vanished when this duration ends (or on another condition specified by you in the Power).

name: Merge with Material
description: You step into a specific material-made object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, merging yourself and your equipment with the material for the duration. To use this Power, you must touch the material. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by non-magical senses. While merged with the material, you cannot see outside, and any Acuity rolls or scores to hear sounds beyond the material have -5. You remain aware of the passage of time and can use Powers on yourself while merged within it. You can use 1 space of movement to exit the material where you entered, which ends the Power. Otherwise, you cannot move. Minor physical damage to the material does not harm you, but partial destruction or alteration of its shape (to the extent that you no longer fit within it) expels you and inflicts 6d6 Magic damage. Destruction of the material (or its transmutation into a different substance) expels you and deals you 35 Magic damage. If expelled, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to where you first entered, and you are Prone. You must specify the material when you gain proficiency with this Power part. Additional proficiency for this part is needed for additional materials.

name: Defend
description: You take the Defend Reaction as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Flood
description: Raise the water level of the area affected by this Power by half a meter. You can choose to instead create waves of double this height, which travel continuously in one direction across the body of water, causing water vessels to capsize on a 25 percent chance, provided the wave is at least half of the vessel's height above the water level. This part of the Power's area of effect is triple the Power's normal area of effect.
op_1_desc: Increase the water-level raised by half a meter.

name: Part Liquid
description: All liquid in the area affected by this power is moved to the sides of the area, and slowly fills in after one minute when this Power ends.

name: Redirect Liquid
description: You direct liquid in the area to move in a direction of your choice, even if it needs to flow over obstacles, up walls, or through other unusual paths. Within the area of effect, the liquid moves as you command, but once it flows beyond this area, it resumes its natural course based on the terrain. The liquid will continue moving in the specified direction until the Power ends or you choose to alter its flow again at any time with no Action cost.

name: Control Weather
description: You take control of the weather within 5 kilometers of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to use this Power, and it ends early if you go indoors. When you activate the Power, you alter the current weather conditions, which are determined by the RM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to gradually take effect. Once they do, you can change the conditions again. When the Power ends, the weather gradually returns to its normal state. When changing the wind, you can also alter its direction.
op_1_desc: Increase the radius by 5 kilometers.
op_2_desc: Allow controlling the weather while not outdoors.

name: Mini-Demi-Realm
description: Create a space accessible through a 1x2 space opening or a 1-space horizontal opening that can have a door or not. The space is a 1x2 meter stone, dirt, or wood demi-realm room. If any creatures are inside when the Power ends, they can choose to appear outside of the opening or remain within the demirealm. Each time you use this Power part, you can choose to connect to a Demi-Realm that you've created before or to create a new one. All items remain within that Demi-Realm.

name: Demi-Realm
description: Create an opening that can have a door or not. The opening goes into a 6x6 space, stone, dirt, or wood room. If any creatures are inside when the Power ends, they can choose to appear outside of the opening or remain within the demirealm. Each time you use this Power part, you can choose to connect to a Demi-Realm that you've created before or to create a new one. All items remain within that demirealm.

name: Realm Shift
description: Transport target to a different realm known to you, or a random unknown realm of the Realm Master's choice. Targets Mental Fortitude or Evasion of the target creature if it is unwilling.

name: Negate Gravity
description: Negate gravity for target for the duration. Targets without gravity simply float, and cannot start or stop moving without aid from external forces or a flying Speed. If hit, they automatically take 3 spaces of movement knockback, including upward, if not holding onto something. Once moving in a direction, they continue moving in that direction at a pace equal to the number of spaces they moved initially, each round, unless they're able to control themselves or stop somehow. Targets Might

name: Redirect Gravity
description: Target's gravity is redirected to a certain direction. They treat the world as if it were for them and all they're wearing as if gravity were in the chosen direction.

name: Increase Gravity
description: The effect of gravity on the target increases by a level. Each level of increased gravity causes fall damage and speed to double, and causes -1 to Reflex and physical attack rolls for each level of gravity increase. When moving on the relative surface gravity pulls towards target's Speed is reduced by 1 for each level of Gravity Increase, to a minimum of 1.
op_1_desc: Increase the level of gravity by 1 and add or increase the die size of the damage taken while affected by this power by 1d4 Bludgeoning for each level of this option.

name: Gravity Center
description: Create a new center of gravity at the target point. Creatures and objects not secured to something within the area of this Power are pulled closer to it on a failed Might roll against your potency. If pulled in, creatures and objects can occupy the same space as other creatures and objects pulled into the gravity center.

name: Freeze Time
description: Time freezes for every target and object, except those your character was touching or carrying before freezing time. Using any Powers or Techniques or making any attacks while time is frozen that would harm another creature causes this Power to end immediately, unfreezing time and resuming initiative order with the turn after yours. The duration for this power is the amount of time you have with frozen time, and time is only frozen within the area of this Power.

name: Rewind Time
description: Time reverses for a target creature or object, returning them to the exact state they were in one round ago. The target returns to the condition and position they occupied at the beginning of the same turn from the previous round, before time was rewound. If the target is unwilling, you target their Evasion.
op_1_desc: Rewind time by an additional round.

name: Terraform
description: Change the terrain within a 75-meter radius in each direction into a terrain of your choice that would occur naturally in nature. The Realm Master decides how the terrain affects targets, but you may decide the terrain type and what it generally looks like. Whatever the chosen terrain is, it cannot immediately harm any creatures, such as a chasm opening beneath a creature, causing it to fall and take more than the damage given by the Power itself.
op_1_desc: Increase the radius by 75 meters.
op_2_desc: Add or increase the die size of 1d2 damage per turn to the terrain landscape targeting Reflex, i.e., inside a volcanic terrain, creatures would roll Reflex at the start of their turn(s), taking 1d2 fire damage on failure.

name: Growth
description: Grow any living plant in range to occupy partially or completely the area of this Power for the duration. This plant can provide Obscurity and take damage like any other plant large enough to fill the space it occupies, as determined by the Realm Master. The plant returns to a normal size after this Power ends.

name: Empower Plant
description: Target plant in range gains the effects of this Power. The plant may use the Power once per round at the beginning of the round, for the duration, or simply be affected by the power for the duration. The plant uses your Power Bonus and Potency for attacks, but has -4 to both.

name: Permanent Duration On Surface
description: Your Power is infused onto a surface (as an image, rune, writing, etc.). You may activate the Power as a Quick Reaction or allow it to activate automatically when a trigger condition is met (e.g., a creature touching or occupying the same space as the rune). You pay the Energy cost when you use the Power, not when you activate the rune. Runes persist until dispelled or activated.

name: Add Weapon to Power
description: You may use a weapon in conjunction with the Power. You can make the weapon's attack as part of the action to use the Power, using the weapon's Attack Roll as normal. For damage, choose between your Power and Martial Bonus. If the Power has a duration longer than one round, the weapon gains the effect for the duration, able to reapply the Power's effects when hitting a creature. Alternatively, you may choose to have the Power last for the duration on the target(s) initially hit instead.

name: Destruction
description: Damage dealt by the Power to objects, walls, ceilings, etc., is doubled.
op_1_desc: Triple damage dealt to objects, walls, ceilings, etc. by this Power instead.

name: Randomize
description: Roll your choice of an even-sided die (1d2-1d100) when using this Power. The result of the Power depends on the number rolled, with each number corresponding to its own set of Power parts. +1 EN for each positive outcome; -1 EN for each negative outcome, which cannot be resisted if used on an ally. This Power part can reduce the Power's total energy to 0 or less, but Powers must always cost at least 1 Energy when finalized. You may have more than one of the same outcome represented in the options to increase its likelihood of being rolled, but must represent that in the Energy paid (ie, three positive 2 Energy outcomes and one negative 4 Energy outcome = 2 Energy total). If this Power lasts longer than one round, you may choose to re-roll this effect at the beginning of each affected creature's turn.
op_1_desc: Set this option's level equal to the Energy Cost for each negative outcome, which cannot be resisted if used on an ally.
op_2_desc: Set this option's level equal to the Energy Cost for each positive outcome.

name: Half-Damage on Fail
description: 50% EN: When this Power misses or is overcome by a creature, you may still determine the damage it would have dealt and deal half of that damage instead.

name: Choose Affected Targets
description: If the Power affects more than one creature, you may choose to exclude some or all of the targets.

name: Activate on Weapon Hit
description: When you hit a target with a weapon attack you may use this Power to affect the target hit without requiring a Power roll.

name: Duration (Days)
description: 800% EN This power lasts for one day.
op_1_desc: 800% EN For a duration of 7 days. 800% EN again for a duration of 14 days.

name: Duration (Hour)
description: 250% EN This power lasts for one hour.
op_1_desc: 250% EN For a duration of 6 hours. 250% EN again for a duration of 12 hours.

name: Duration (Minute)
description: 75% EN This power lasts for one minute.
op_1_desc: 75% EN for a duration of 10 minutes, 75% EN again for a duration of 30 minutes.

name: Duration (Round)
description: 12.5% EN This power lasts for two rounds.
op_1_desc: 12.5% EN for each additional round up to 5 rounds.

name: Use Power Again on Overcome
description: 50% EN: When the target of this Power overcome's it or dies before the duration of the Power ends you may use a quick action or reaction to choose a new target for this Power, targeting them as normal. The Power must have a duration longer than 1 round. The overcome cannot be the initial overcome when the Power was used, it must be a later overcome such as a target rolling a defense against your potency on it's turn.

name: Still Affects on Overcome
description: 25% EN: When this Power would be overcome as to not affect a target, it still applies one turn of the effect, but deal no damage (If any). This requires the Power to have a duration longer than one round.

name: Different Effects Each Round
description: X EN: Separate this Power into different parts that each take effect on a set round of the Power's duration. Only pay the duration cost and Power energy cost of the most expensive round effect/part of this Power. When creating a Power using this part, only pay the TP cost for the round with the highest TP cost, not for each option.
op_1_desc: -0.25 EN Use to adjust EN cost accordingly.
op_2_desc: -0.5 TP Use to adjust TP cost accordingly.

name: Decrease Multiple Action Penalty
description: Reduce the Multiple Action Penalty of the target creature by 1.
op_1_desc: Decrease the penalty by another 1.

name: Power Range
description: Add a range of 3 spaces to this power.
op_1_desc: 0.5 EN for each additional 3 spaces.

name: Requires Materials
description: -12.5% EN: Power requires materials to perform. You must use materials with a gold value equal to 2 times the energy cost of the Power in order to perform.
op_1_desc: -12.5% EN: For each additional +1 to this multiplier for required gold cost to a maximum decrease total of -75% EN from this part (equating to a total multiplier of 7 times energy cost in gold requirement).

name: Ends on Effect/Damage Threshold
description: -25% EN: The Power ends immediately upon dealing damage equal to 3/4 its maximum damage capability (if one round) or 1 1/2 of its maximum damage capability (if it lasts more than one round). Alternatively, the Power ends when it has inflicted a condition for 3/4 of its duration without the target overcoming it. Can only be added to offensive Powers

name: Deadly Contingency
description: -50% EN: You may choose to end the Power using a quick action only on your turn. If the Power is overcome or ended in any other way during its duration, you enter the dying condition with -1 Health. A Power is eligible for this part only if it has a duration of 3 rounds or longer, and can be overcome or ended by means other than the Dispel Power Part.

name: Immune to Effect on Overcome
description: -25% EN: When a target overcomes any part of this Power, that part of the Power can no longer target them. Can only added to offensive Powers

name: Reverse Effects
description: -X EN: If your Power benefits yourself or an ally, you can add a negative effect for you or an ally to reduce the Power's cost by an amount equal to 50% the energy cost of the negative part. The negative effect cannot be nullified or reduced by you or an ally.
op_1_desc: -0.5 EN per 1 EN of the reversed part. (Set this increase equal to the energy cost of the reversed part.)

name: Stipulation
description: -12.5% EN: Part or all of a Power affects only specific targets based on creature type, elemental affinity, species, or other traits. Alternatively, the Power may only affect creatures under specific conditions (e.g., being grappled, dying, being terminal, etc). As another alternative, this Power can only be used under certain conditions such as while within darkness.
op_1_desc: -6.25%% EN to add another acceptable stipulation in addition to the first (an additional creature type, or condition needed.) I.e. Undead or Constructs, grappled or immobile, etc.
op_2_desc: -3.125%% EN for each additional acceptable stipulation in addition to the first two (an additional creature type, or condition needed.) I.e. Undead or Constructs, grappled or immobile, etc.

name: Not Activated until Target Moves
description: -25% EN: Power's effects do not activate unless the target moves. If they remain still until the Power's duration ends, the Power has no effect. Only reduce the cost based on parts that deal damage or effects, not additional parts. This part can only be added to offensive Powers

name: One Round Adaptation
description: -25% EN: If the Power meets these criteria, its cost is reduced by ¼: Lasts only 1 round. Only applies adaptation effects (other than Health or Energy regain). Is not over 10 EN in cost.

name: Targets Additional Defense
description: -25% EN: Target may roll your choice of defense against your potency. On success, they are unaffected. If the target is an ally it must make this roll against your default potency (ie your potency without any bonuses or penalties).

name: Proximity Requirement
description: -12.5% EN: You must remain within a certain range of the target of this Power. If either you or the target is ever beyond this range, the Power ends. The range is equal to the range of this Power. Must be added to a Power that targets another creature and has a duration longer than 1 round.

name: Merged Potency
description: -12.5% EN: If Power targets multiple defenses with lingering effects, you may combine those into one targeted defense that makes sense, causing both effects to end together once overcome. (Such as a wrap of necrotic cords targeting fortitude and might, combining these to just might for overcoming the entire lingering effect, or a charm Power that also deals psychic damage targeting resolve alone instead of mental fortitude and resolve). Can only be added to offensive Powers

name: Transferred Effect
description: -25% EN: This Power's effects do not activate until after an amount of time equal to a fourth of this Power's duration (minimum 1 round). If at any point a target affected by the Power deals melee damage to another creature before the Power activates, the Power transfers to that new creature and the one fourth timer restarts. If the Power has a duration longer than 1 round, the Power can transfer to a new target each round. When the duration of the Power is met, the Power activates. Can only be added to offensive Powers.

name: Target's Possession
description: -25% EN: This Power has this energy reduction only if a significant possession of the target is used by the Power. This could be part of a creature's body, a weapon, a piece of armor, etc. but it must be significant to the target. Can only be added to offensive Powers

name: Requires Skill Roll
description: -12.5% EN: You use the Ability Roll action as part of the action to use this Power, with which you must make a DS-15 skill roll using a skill chosen upon creation of this Power. The Power fails on a failed roll. The skill roll should thematically match the Power's flavor, be approved by your RM, and cannot be automatically succeeded with any feats, traits, or Powers. The roll is affected by action rules as normal including the need to spend AP if the Ability roll action has already been taken, and suffering the multiple action penalty.
op_1_desc: -12.5% EN: From the Power if increasing the skill Roll DS by +5 to a maximum DS of 25.

name: Wish
description: Reduce the cost of a Power to 90 EN as long as it's total cost is under 200 EN. You gain 2 levels of exhaustion that cannot be recovered in any way other than the base exhaustion rules for each time you use this Power (after the first time) each full recovery.
op_1_desc: -1 EN Use this to reduce cost of Power to 90 EN.

name: Dispel Immune
description: 25% EN: Power cannot be nullified, absorbed, dispelled, or reduced in any other way than deflecting or reflecting or through a Power contest.

name: Password
description: Set a specified password that, when spoken, either activates a Power or causes a creature who spoke the password to either be unaffected or affected by the Power. Power must have a duration longer than 1 round.

name: Choice
description: You may separate portions of this Power and upon using the Power choose which of these portions of the Power to use. You pay the energy cost to use this Power equal to the portion that costs the most energy. Example: You have a Power that has a range of 6 spaces, causes blindness, and deals your choice of 1d10 fire or 1d8 necrotic damage. The Power part's for range and blindness have a total cost together that you add to the more expensive of the two damage options.
op_1_desc: -1 EN Use this to reduce cost of Power parts to highest within choice.

name: Split Power Parts into Groups
description: Group of Power Parts: You may treat part of a Power as a separate Power to apply unique stipulations (e.g., only part of a Power lingers). Calculate each Power individually, then combine the costs for the total EN cost.

name: No Sightline Required
description: 25% EN: Your Power can target a point within range without needing sight or perception of that area. Attacks against obscured creatures ignore the obscurity if it was due to low vision alone. Example: Darkness obscures an area lightly giving -1 to your Power overcome roll. This would be ignored. If this instead was a wall completely obscuring the target, you couldn't target the creature because it's a physical and visual obscurity.

name: Multiple Overcome(s) Required
description: 50% EN (of all parts being overcome): Target must overcome your Power's effect(s) one additional time in order to avoid the effect(s). If the Power has duration, then the attempts to overcome need not be consecutive. +25% EN for each additional overcome required.
op_1_desc: +25% EN for each additional overcome required.

name: Swim
description: Target gains a Swim Speed equal to half its Speed.
op_1_desc: The swim speed is equal to the target's Speed instead.

name: Polymorph
description: Target creature transforms into an animal or beast. You may choose any Beast with a level equal to or less than the target’s level. The target’s game statistics are replaced by those of the Beast form, though it retains its alignment, personality, creature type, Health, and Energy. It Overheals an amount equal to the Beast form’s Health. The transformation ends early if the target's Health is reduced to equal or blow it's normal Health Maximum. In its new form, the target is limited to actions allowed by its anatomy, unable to speak or use Powers. The target’s gear merges into the new form, and it cannot access or benefit from this equipment during the transformation. Target's Fortitude if unwilling. You or the willing target affected can choose to end this Power with a Free Action; otherwise, it remains in effect.
op_1_desc: Increase the maximum level of Beast you can polymorph into by 1.

name: Evade
description: You take the Evade Action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Take the Evade action an additional time for each level of this option.

name: Material Shape
description: Cause a specified material made object of one and a half cubic meters or smaller, or a section of the material no larger than one and a half cubic meters in any dimension, and mold it into a shape of your choice. For instance, you might transform a large piece into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or carve a small passage through a one-and-a-half-foot-thick wall. You could also alter that type of material door or its frame to seal it shut. The shaped object may include up to two hinges and a latch, but intricate mechanical details cannot be created. You must specify the material when you gain proficiency with this Power part. Additional proficiency for this part is needed for additional materials.

name: Stop Aging
description: A target object or willing creature cannot be affected by the effects of aging. Target's Fortitude if unwilling.

name: Sustain Body
description: Target does not require food or water to live for this Power's duration. When this Power ends, the target returns to whatever nourishment state it was when this Power was used.

name: Specified Exceptions
description: When you use this Power, you may specify a creature or objects who are either immune to the Power's effects, or are the only creature and/or objects which can be affected by the effect. +1.5 EN for each additional target you can specify.
op_1_desc: +1.5 EN for each additional target you can specify.

name: Specialized
description: 12.5% EN: Part or all of the Power causes either +1 on attack rolls against target or -1 to target's Defense rolls based on criteria like creature type or species (choose one).
op_1_desc: +12.5% EN for each additional +1 or -1.

name: Alternate Targeted Defense
description: 12.5% EN: Choose a defense your Power targets and change it to target an alternative defense instead. This defense must make sense for how the Power works and function in a way that makes sense such as a tsunami Power targeting might instead of reflex as an area of effect Bludgeoning damage Power.

name: Split Damage Dice
description: A 'Split' damage dice is when dice could be represented by less dice of greater size, but are 'split' into smaller sizes instead. Ie 2d6 instead of 1d12 represents one die 'split' by splitting 1d12 into 2d6.
op_1_desc: Each additional time a die is split, ie 3d4 instead of 1d12 is 2 splits instead of 1, this part increases by one.

name: No Attack
description: -12.5% EN: This technique is performed without an attack.

name: Ignore Damage Reduction
description: Ignore 1 point of damage reduction the target has with this technique.
op_1_desc: Increase the ignored damage reduction by 1.
op_2_desc: You continually ignore damage reduction for one minute instead of just when using this technique.

name: Dodge
description: Take the Dodge reaction as part of this technique. If this is the only part, it can be done as a Free Reaction.

name: Critical Hit
description: Reduce the Critical Range of this attack by 1.
op_1_desc: Reduce the Critical Range by an additional 1.

name: Focus
description: You take the Focus Action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Take the Focus Action an additional time.

name: Help
description: You take the Help Reaction as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is neither a general part, it can be taken as a Free Reaction.

name: Search/Detect
description: You take the Search or Detect action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action or Reaction.

name: Stealth/Hide
description: You take the Stealth/Hide Action as part of this Technique. If this is the only Technique part that is not a general part, it can be taken as a Free Action.
op_1_desc: Sustain this action on future turns without any Action Points for one minute. You may also switch from Stealthing to Hiding or vice versa once per turn without an Action Point cost during this time.
